title: outlined ores_
description: This texture pack shows all ores but fully outlined.

This pack makes it way eaier to find ores that you would've missed!![LOOK](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5ae9808223162648bc6c4461a1c5722fca199fc.png)
